data.one_liner: Inspect HTTP(S) requests, responses, and network traffic with a built-in UI and local storage.
data.what_it_does: Chucker Flutter acts as an interceptor for Dio, Http, and Chopper clients. It saves network requests and responses locally and provides an in-app UI and notification system for inspecting, searching, and sharing network traffic.
use_when: You need to debug and inspect network calls directly inside your Flutter app during development.
You want an easy way to view pretty JSON, trees, and image previews for API requests and responses.
avoid_when: You are running in a strict production environment where network traffic inspection tools should be completely disabled (unless explicitly enabled via showOnRelease).
You use a networking library that is not supported by Chucker's built-in interceptors or clients.
strengths: Supports multiple popular HTTP libraries including Dio, Http, and Chopper.
Provides an in-app UI, notifications, search, and sharing capabilities.
Works across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires manual integration of interceptors or client wrappers for every network request.
Requires setting a minimum SDK version of 22 for Android.
data.setup_notes: For Android, you need to make minSdkVersion 22 in your build.gradle file. Wire ChuckerFlutter.navigatorKey into your root MaterialApp or router configuration.
